who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
what: A file replaced by rename (what `sed -i` and editors do) is sometimes read by the daemon as empty: the build fails with E0601 `main` not found and stays failed until the file is written again.
cost: several wrong measurements and two lanes tripped by it
cause: the daemon reads the path between the unlink and the create, or acts on the delete event alone
workaround: overwrite bytes in place when scripting edits
